## Wave 5 Summary

This wave closes the §VII.AY substrate-cocycle-ratio arbitration (CF-A R_machine recompute + CF-B Element-5 tolerance/Stage-2/Stage-3), executes the §VII.AR FULL-tier N=4 conviction-or-acquittal test (Connes-Chamseddine 1996 physical regularization, NOT SCHEMATIC) plus the filter-geometry audit, and lands two §VII.AW registry-write moves: the framework's THIRD STAGE-3-PERMANENT promotion (§VII.AW.OP-PROJ SUBSTRATE-CLOCK-UNIQUENESS-THEOREM) and the resolution of the long-standing `§VII.AW.OP-PROJ` label-collision via a slot-rename of the rejected SU(3)-Coloured-Chirality STAGE-0 candidate to a free §VII slot. The carry-forward source is the S92 W-5 §VII.AY workshop (CF-A/CF-B), the S92 S-1 §VII.AR substrate-naturalness audit (V.1/V.2 reclassification rule + E5 scope correction), the S92 W4 WP (filter-geometry + §VII.AW STAGE-3), and the S92 housekeeping §D ledger item HK-S93-W9-1 (§VII.AW slot-rename).

**Tier structure (cross-cutting per mack-synthesis §V.1 sequencing)**: W5-1 is **Tier-1** (anchor-supplying / decision-closing — the substrate arbiter for the F1-vs-F2 historiography). W5-2 and W5-5 are **Tier-3** (Stage-2 cross-axis PASS-AND + STAGE-3-PERMANENT flips, each gated on its Tier-1/Tier-2 prerequisites + substrate-input-orthogonality structural ceiling). W5-3 and W5-4 are §VII.AR substrate-physics computes (not part of the STAGE-3 tier ladder; W5-3 dual-prior-pre-registered). W5-6 is a registry-write hygiene move (label-collision resolution). The STAGE-3 flips in W5-2 + W5-5 participate in the cross-wave slot-pre-allocation lockfile (see W0-1 + the lockfile note in this wave's Decision Point).

    ~5-7 other algebra-INVARIANT functionals enumerated in the §VII.U.2 four-corner table at
    Cell IV) under BOTH the L∞-box filter `max(p,q) ≤ L_max` AND the triangular filter
    `p+q ≤ L_max`. For each observable × filter geometry, scan L_max ∈ {6, 8, 10, 12} on the
    block-diagonal master cache and extract the convergence rate to the L_max=12 reference value.
    Verify the §W4-6 w5b47_raw finding (L∞-box is substrate-natural at d=4) GENERALIZES: ALL Cell IV
    observables match the L∞-box < triangular convergence-rate ordering, OR identify the boundary
    observable where the equivalence breaks (sub-classifying Cell IV by a filter-geometry sub-axis).
    Re-use the w5b47_raw convention from s88_w5b_corner_iv_level2_envelope.py::collect_truncated_spectrum.
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s93_w5_4_vii_ar_filter_geometry_audit.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set-wide inequality (per-observable convergence-rate ordering)"
  form: "for ALL obs ∈ Cell_IV: rate_Linf_box(obs) faster-than rate_triangular(obs) at the d=4 Weyl-law tail"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:

  direction: "="   # set-membership: every observable in Cell IV satisfies the ordering

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "L_max ∈ {6, 8, 10, 12} (4-point integer mesh per observable per filter)"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "48 (≈6 Cell IV observables × 2 filter geometries × 4 L_max values; per W4 WP:784 the ~6-observable × 2-filter × {6,8,10,12} scan)"
  L_max: "{6, 8, 10, 12} scan (reference value at L_max=12; the master cache supports filtering to each L_max)"
  scan_range: "L_max ∈ {6, 8, 10, 12}; observables = Var_a + ~5-7 other algebra-INVARIANT functionals from §VII.U.2 Cell IV table"
  step_size: "L_max step = 2 (discrete)"
  tolerance: "convergence-rate ordering verdict per observable: L∞-box rate must be faster than triangular rate; the SET-universal PASS requires all observables to satisfy it"
  scheme: "FW"
  convention: "VII-AR-Cell-IV-Linf-box-vs-triangular-filter-geometry-w5b47_raw"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg (block-diagonal cache filtered per (p,q) sector × 2 filter geometries; matrix reductions per sector)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap", "s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz", "s88_w5b_corner_iv_level2_envelope.py"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY (the "L∞-box converges FASTER than triangular" is a direction claim)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "L∞-box (max(p,q)≤L_max) converges FASTER than triangular (p+q≤L_max) to the continuum
            value for all Cell IV algebra-INVARIANT observables, at the d=4 Weyl-law tail."

    Substitution chain:
      Step 1: N_box(L_max) = #{(p,q) : max(p,q) ≤ L_max} = (L_max+1)²   [L∞-box admission count]
      Step 2: N_tri(L_max) = #{(p,q) : p+q ≤ L_max} = (L_max+1)(L_max+2)/2   [triangular admission count]
      Step 3: N_box / N_tri = 2(L_max+1)/(L_max+2) → 2 as L_max → ∞   [box admits ~2× the sectors at large L_max]
      Step 4: at the d=4 Weyl-law tail dN(λ) ~ λ³ dλ, the high-(p,q) sectors carry the dominant residual
              spectral weight; the box filter admits the corner sectors (large p, small q and vice versa)
              that the triangular filter excludes ⇒ the box-filtered observable captures more of the
              continuum tail at fixed L_max.
      Step 5: ⇒ for a convergent algebra-INVARIANT functional, the box-filtered truncation residual decays
              FASTER (the box reaches the continuum value at smaller L_max) ⇒ rate_box > rate_tri.
      Conclusion: the §W4-6 w5b47_raw finding (L∞-box substrate-natural) is PREDICTED to generalize across
                  Cell IV; the audit tests whether ANY observable BREAKS this (e.g., a functional dominated by
                  low-(p,q) sectors where the corner-admission advantage vanishes), in which case Cell IV
                  sub-classifies by a filter-geometry sub-axis.

    sha256: "1aa90bb157dbb615eec808fa2a8a211b87e656c2a3ae32f03358d7911190790c"

# ---- Output artifacts ----
output_artifacts:

    path: "computations/session-93/s93_w5_4_vii_ar_filter_geometry_audit.py"

  data:

    artifact_kind: "data"
    optional: false

    #   ordering_satisfied (per obs bool), set_universal_PASS (bool), boundary_observable (str or "none")

    path: "computations/session-93/s93_w5_4_vii_ar_filter_geometry_audit.png"
    artifact_kind: "plot"
    optional: false
    # per-observable convergence curves (box vs triangular) across L_max ∈ {6,8,10,12}
  verdict_line:
    path: "computations/session-93/s93_gate_verdicts.txt"
    artifact_kind: "verdict_line"
    must_contain: "^S93-W5-4-VII-AR-FILTER-GEOMETRY-AUDIT:.* audit_sha256=[a-f0-9]{64}"
    companion_row_required: true
    schema_v2_3tuple_required: false
  wp_section:

    artifact_kind: "wp_section"

    must_contain:
      - "\\*\\*Status\\*\\*:.*COMPLETED"
      - "\\*\\*Verdict\\*\\*:.*(PASS|FAIL|INFO)"
      - "\\*\\*Output Artifacts\\*\\*"
      - "\\*\\*MCP Pre-Compute Audit\\*\\*"

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  ALL Cell IV algebra-INVARIANT observables match the L∞-box < triangular convergence-rate ordering ⇒
  the §W4-6 w5b47_raw finding generalizes uniformly; the L∞-box filter is the substrate-natural truncation
  geometry across Cell IV (no filter-geometry sub-axis needed). Strengthens the §VII.U.2 Cell IV

## Wave 5 → Wave 6+ Decision Point

Wave 5 produces no outputs consumed by Wave 6 (W6 is the connes-ncg chirality / HH^1 / Pati-Salam Stage-2 wave on §VII.AQ / §VII.AZ / §VII.BB / §VII.BE — disjoint slots). The cross-cutting dependencies are INTRA-Wave-5 and to the cross-wave lockfile:

- **W5-1 → W5-2 (MANDATORY in-session chain)**: W5-2's 3-axis Stage-2 re-dispatch MUST test against the W5-1 substrate-sourced R_machine pin. If W5-1 = PASS → W5-2 proceeds with the substrate-sourced pin; the §VII.AY STAGE-3-PERMANENT flip is the substrate-pin-layer unblock. If W5-1 = FAIL → W5-2 honestly closes PRE-REG-INC (blocked_by W5-1); the §VII.AY STAGE-3 promotion is deferred. If W5-1 = INFO → W5-2 may record Stage-3 ELIGIBILITY but HOLD the STAGE-3-PERMANENT flip until W5-1's consumer re-validation completes.
- **W5-3 → §VII.AR reclassification (pre-registered, S-1 V.1)**: if W5-3 = PASS (FULL-PASS) → §VII.AR PASS-A CONFIRMED, BOTH-FOLD framing ratified, STAGE-3 eligibility on both PASS-A and PASS-B. If W5-3 = FAIL (FULL-FAIL) → §VII.AR PASS-A reclassified to METHODOLOGY-floor-only (mack annotation), STAGE-3 eligibility on PASS-B alone. The composite §W4-1 verdict is UNAFFECTED (verdict permanence) in both branches. The dual prior (~0.65 FULL-FAIL) maps the outcome with ≥ 0.9 posterior re-allocation; no re-narrativization at synthesis.
- **W5-4 → §VII.U.2 Cell IV coherence**: PASS strengthens the Cell IV truncation-geometry coherence (L∞-box substrate-natural uniformly); FAIL sub-classifies Cell IV by a filter-geometry sub-axis.
- **W5-2 + W5-5 STAGE-3 flips → cross-wave lockfile (W0-1)**: BOTH the §VII.AY (W5-2) and §VII.AW (W5-5) STAGE-3-PERMANENT flips participate in the S93 slot-pre-allocation lockfile alongside the other STAGE-3 flips (§VII.AU W2, §VII.AV W3, §VII.AX W4, §VII.BB W6). The W5 gates record their STAGE-3 flips in `sessions/framework/s90-slot-pre-allocation-lockfile.md` (or the S93 lockfile if W0-1 allocates one) to avoid parallel-writer registry-write collisions. W5-6's rename also touches the lockfile (the RESERVED-FOR-WORKSHOP-W7-CF-45-VII-AW block) — sequence W5-6 to write the lockfile AFTER W5-5's lockfile row if both run concurrently, OR use the append-only Python writer pattern (`open("a")`) to avoid mtime races.

**Tier-ordering within Wave 5 (mack §V.1)**: W5-1 (Tier-1) must complete before W5-2 (Tier-3). W5-5 (Tier-3) and W5-6 (hygiene) are independent of W5-1/W5-2/W5-3/W5-4 and may run in parallel with them, subject to the lockfile-write sequencing above. W5-3 (§VII.AR FULL-tier) and W5-4 (filter-geometry) are independent computes.
